correctness.rationale: For N(s,t)=max(|s|,|t|,(|s|+|t|)/sqrt2), each branch <= Euclidean norm. The unit ball octagon has eight vertices from (1,sqrt2-1),(sqrt2-1,1) by signs/swaps, all Euclidean radius d=sqrt(4-2sqrt2), so convexity gives Euclidean/d <= N <= Euclidean on every vector. For N-unit x,y, parallelogram identity proves [N(x+y)^2+N(x-y)^2]/4>=1/d^2=(2+sqrt2)/4. At x=(1,0), y=(1/sqrt2,1/sqrt2), both unit, N(x+y)=1+1/sqrt2 and N(x-y)=1/sqrt2, attaining bound. Independently numerically recalculated exact witness and reviewed Q(sqrt2) checker identities; analytic Euclidean sandwich proves continuum, not finite sampling.
